response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates strong overall software engineering expertise and some financial-services exposure through RIDE Capital, but fundamentally lacks the mandatory technical requirements. The role requires 5-10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows with strong SQL/SQL Server expertise. Bogdan has only 6 months of C++ experience from 2014-2015, no demonstrated Windows platform background, and primarily specializes in web development with JavaScript/TypeScript and NoSQL databases. His career trajectory over the past decade has moved away from systems-level programming toward cloud, web, and AI infrastructure.
strengths: Strong 20-year software development background with proven expertise in testing practices, TDD, and CI/CD pipeline implementation
Demonstrated communication skills through multiple technical talks, workshops, and active open-source contributions
Some exposure to financial/investment domain through RIDE Capital role reshaping German investment practices
concerns: Only 6 months of C++ experience from 2014-2015; mandatory requirement is 5-10 years of recent, hands-on C++ development
No demonstrated Windows platform development experience; background is exclusively Linux and web-based systems
Primary expertise in NoSQL databases (MongoDB) and modern web stacks; limited SQL Server/Oracle experience required for capital markets systems
